subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB1025
title: Requires the Department of Land Conservation and Development to study lodging near waterways and submit findings to the interim committees of the Legislative Assembly related to land use no later than September 15, 2026.
headline: SB 1025 did not pass

claims.text: SB 1025 was introduced in the Senate on February 18, 2025.
SB 1025 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
